meta.name: algorithms-education
meta.description: Skills and conventions for an educational algorithms and data structures repository. Use this skill whenever working on algorithm implementations, data structure code, LeetCode-style problems, graph theory, dynamic programming, or any Java-based educational coding project. Trigger on mentions of: algorithms, data structures, graph theory, sorting, searching, trees, DP, BFS, DFS, linked lists, heaps, segment trees, union-find, or any request to write, refactor, document, or test educational code. Also trigger when the user asks to "clean up", "simplify", "document", "refactor" or "add tests" to algorithm code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编写、重构、测试算法与数据结构代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在学习或教授算法与数据结构，需要编写或改进Java实现。
copy.tagline_en: Write, refactor, and test algorithm and data structure code

howto.what: Claude 会按照教育算法仓库的规范编写代码：为每个方法添加详细注释（包括时间/空间复杂度），编写覆盖边界情况的测试，使用简洁的变量名，避免 Java Streams，并主动检查常见 bug。
howto.when: 当你提到算法、数据结构、图论、排序、搜索、树、动态规划、BFS、DFS、链表、堆、线段树、并查集等关键词，或要求编写、重构、文档化、测试教育性代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Bellman-Ford 算法实现最短路径，并加上详细注释。
say.note: Claude 会生成带方法注释、行内注释和复杂度分析的代码。

say.text: 给这段二分查找代码写测试，覆盖空数组和单元素情况。
say.note: Claude 会创建测试文件，包含基本路径、边界和异常场景。

say.text: 重构这个 DFS 实现，减少嵌套并添加早期返回。
say.note: Claude 会应用简化策略，保持代码清晰且教育性。

howto.what_en: Claude will write code following educational repository conventions: add detailed comments (including time/space complexity) for each method, write tests covering edge cases, use short variable names, avoid Java Streams, and proactively check for common bugs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention algorithms, data structures, graph theory, sorting, searching, trees, DP, BFS, DFS, linked lists, heaps, segment trees, union-find, etc., or ask to write, refactor, document, or test educational code.

say_en.text: Implement shortest path using Bellman-Ford with detailed comments.
Write tests for this binary search covering empty array and single element.
Refactor this DFS to reduce nesting and add early returns.
